title: Noen, noe, ingen, and ingenting
goal: Choose noen, noe, ingen, and ingenting in simple Bokmål sentences.

objectives.statement: Choose noen, noe, ingen, and ingenting in simple Bokmål sentences.

sections.title: A study evening with an empty cupboard

spans.value: Lina has invited several classmates to her flat for a study evening. Marius arrives early to help her prepare.
Kommer noen av de andre snart?

blocks.translation: Are any of the others coming soon?

spans.value: Nei, ingen kommer før klokka seks.

blocks.translation: No, no one is coming before six o’clock.

spans.value: Greit. Har vi noe å servere?

blocks.translation: All right. Do we have anything to serve?

spans.value: Vi har noen epler og noen kjeks.

blocks.translation: We have some apples and some biscuits.

spans.value: Fint. Har vi noe å drikke?

blocks.translation: Good. Do we have anything to drink?

spans.value: Det er ingen kaffe igjen, og vi har ikke noe te.

blocks.translation: There is no coffee left, and we don’t have any tea.

spans.value: Så vi har ingenting å drikke?

blocks.translation: So we have nothing to drink?

spans.value: Vi har vann. Men ingen vil ha bare vann på en fredagskveld!

blocks.translation: We have water. But no one wants only water on a Friday evening!

sections.title: Cumulative transfer: preparing for a train journey

spans.value: Now move away from Lina’s study evening. Jonas and Amalie are packing for an early train. They need to check whether anyone else is joining them, whether they have food, and whether anything is missing.

prompt.value: Sort the sentences by the form and function of the indefinite pronouns.

explanation.value: «Noen» brukes om personer og ting i flertall. «Noe» viser til en ting, mengde, stoff eller en handling. «Ingen» brukes alene om personer eller foran et substantiv for å si at ingen av dem finnes. «Ingenting» viser alene til noe som mangler.

Ingenting: ingen ting eller handling, uten navngitt substantiv

prompt.value: The shop has no customers. Three boxes are outside the stockroom, there is a little coffee in the break room, and everything is checked. Write a message to your colleague about how ready you are to close. Use «noen», «noe», «ingen», and «ingenting».

explanation.value: «Noen» viser til personer eller ting i flertall; «noe» til en ting, mengde, stoff eller handling; «ingen» står foran en person eller et substantiv som mangler; «ingenting» står alene.

payload.judge_prompt: Check every criterion as gating: message-purpose, supplied-facts, uses-noen, uses-noe, uses-ingen, and uses-ingenting. Treat none of them as observational.

criteria.instruction: Replies to the colleague with a message that reports whether the shop is ready to close.
Preserves the supplied facts without inventing a contradiction.
Uses noen for a person or plural countable referent.
Uses noe for a thing, substance, amount, or infinitive pattern.
Uses ingen for an absent person or before a noun.
Uses ingenting as a stand-alone form meaning nothing.
